inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information gathered from interviews, a teacher was heard using an unpleasant yelling type of tone with the children. Note: This teacher is no longer employed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several rooms were observed with peeling paint and an exposed holes in the wall accessible to children.  Several rooms were observed with dirty toys.  Several broken toys were observed on the playground which were sharp to the touch.  This was corrected when the broken toys were removed from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: Two employees who are no longer employed at the center for more than 7 days were still active on the background checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The director was missing a current SIDS training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Several electrical outlets were observed with no cover which one was located outside on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: The daily maintenance checklist was not up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: Five cribs were observed with an additional foam pad added in the crib.  This was corrected when the director removed them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: A few cribs were observed with loose fitted sheets that can create a suffocation or entrapment hazard because an infant's face can become covered by the excess fabric.   This was corrected when the sheets were changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: A staff that was hired was observed in the infant room without having a validate background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Designating Director: The last communication with the governing body/designee in reference to having a qualified director in place was on January 20th.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Designating Director (26 TAC §746.201(4))

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: The 2-year-old room had 21 total during naptime with two caregivers, and a third worker came in after lunch.  There were 3-17-month-olds included in the total which they are considered infants.  Reduction for naptime is only allowed for 18 months and older which does not include calculating the specified age group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: Four employees completed an online Pediatric CPR course which is not allowed per licensing.  A CPR class must be taken in person.  One employee's CPR was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: A current activity plan was not posted for all the rooms.  This was corrected when a current activity plan was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information provided throughout this investigation, a 4-year-old was placed outside by herself in front of the director?s see through office back door that leads out on to the playground. occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The infant room had one teacher with seven infants which made this room over ratio by three. occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on the information gathered during this investigation, the caregiver in the 3-year-old room was receiving complaints from parents regarding injuries on the children such as bites and scratches.   She was never able to explain to management or parents about the bites and scratches.  Therefore, the center made the decision to terminate the caregiver due to the 3-year-old room not being supervised properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
